permitted_base_oils_restrictions.notes: Sourced from industry standard knowledge (base oil rule of thumb for older API categories, CF through CI-4), not from the product datasheet. Packages whose highest API claim is an older category (CF/CF-4/CG-4/CH-4/CI-4 era, before CJ-4/CK-4) are typically Group I/II/III compatible. Highest claim here: API CI-4. CI-4 is treated as part of this older family. Rule of thumb only, not a supplier statement or an API 1509 restriction (API 1509 governs base oil interchange testing, not which groups a package may use). Datasheet says claims apply only 'with appropriate base oils', so confirm with Lubrizol.
